title: Acronym
hints: `strings.Fields` splits on runs of whitespace. Turn hyphens into spaces first with `strings.ReplaceAll`.
Loop over the words with `for _, word := range strings.Fields(...)`, then over each word's runes with `for _, r := range word` until you find a letter.
When `unicode.IsLetter(r)` is true: `b.WriteRune(unicode.ToUpper(r))` and `break` out of the inner loop. Return `b.String()` at the end.
